evidence.claim: On 12 August 2026 the Democratic Republic of the Congo published a situation update reporting 4,566 confirmed cases and 2,128 related deaths from data up to 11 August 2026.

More than 300 children have died in the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo; UNICEF reports children represent almost one third of all deaths while accounting for nearly a quarter of confirmed cases.

At least a dozen facilities treating Ebola have been attacked, largely due to fear, misinformation and deep community mistrust of outside authorities; some 13,000 community workers have been deployed by the Congolese health ministry and partners including Africa CDC, UNICEF and WHO.

OCHA reported that children and women continue to bear a disproportionate share of the Ebola outbreak in Ituri, the most affected province, and that maternal deaths in Ituri have nearly doubled since the outbreak began.
